comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Firewall and security vendor; shares networking hardware and subscriptions but sells enterprise cybersecurity, not IoT connectivity or device management.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Enterprise IoT connectivity management, SIMs, routers and cloud platform sold to OEMs and enterprises; closely overlaps Digi's IoT connectivity business.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: Fleet telematics and asset tracking solutions sold as vertical SaaS; not general-purpose IoT connectivity hardware like routers or modules.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Engineering software (CAD, PLM) for manufacturers; pure software with no connectivity hardware.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Telecom carrier voice and IP/optical networking equipment; different customers and products from IoT edge connectivity.

comps.label: C6
comps.reason: Designs enterprise edge devices built by contract manufacturers, sold via channel with software subscriptions; similar hardware-plus-software model, though scanning and mobile computing focus.
